property.name: Hotel Zarea
property.ownership: 100% state-owned, administered by the Public Property Agency

transaction.depositNote: 10% of the initial price, counted toward the price for the winner
transaction.auctionPlace: Public Property Agency, Strada Vasile Alecsandri 78, 4th floor, room 402, Chișinău
conditions: The civil-protection shelter in the basement (520 m², 400 persons, commissioned 1981) is public property. It is excluded from the sale, stays with the State, and the buyer must preserve and keep it operable, including during any reconstruction or modernisation.
The transformer station on the plot (cadastral no. 0100418.216.02) belongs to Premier Energy. Access and a right of way over 0.0260 ha must be maintained for its operation and upkeep.
steps: Consult the documents at the agency's office and visit the property by appointment, on working days 08:00 to 17:00.
Apply, on paper, at the agency

Submit the application form (Annex 1 to Government Decision 136/2009) at Strada Vasile Alecsandri 78, Chișinău, before the deadline, with the attachments listed in the notice and proof that the deposit and the fee have been paid. The notice provides no online channel.
Take part in the open outcry auction at the agency's office, in person or through an authorised representative.
The winner pays within 20 days of the auction minutes. The contract is signed after Competition Council clearance.

submission.where: In person, on paper, at the Public Property Agency, Strada Vasile Alecsandri 78, Chișinău
submission.form: Application form per Annex 1 to Government Decision 136/2009
attachments: Moldovan companies: beneficial-owner declaration (Annex 1¹), State Register extract, registration decision, last financial statements, declaration of no incompatibility
Individuals: identity card copy and bank details for the deposit refund
Proof of payment of the deposit and of the participation fee
